derivation:
by
  rcases hf with ⟨e, rfl⟩; ext x i
  simpa [LinearEquiv.dotProductContragredient, LinearMap.funLeft] using (dotProduct_comp_equiv_symm x (Pi.single i 1) e.symm)
explanation: Mathlib's identity transfers a coordinate permutation across a dot product. Applying it to a single-coordinate vector computes each coordinate of the contragredient, after unfolding its definition.
